unavailable_fields.nccl_algorithm_protocol_channel_selectio: Communication diagnostics disabled: observations.json reports the communication capability not_applicable with reason 'communication diagnostics disabled', and request.json has distributed_backend=null with communication='off'; the collected torch trace contains no NCCL kernels, so nccl_tuning has no collectives to sample and kernel entry names could not identify protocol anyway.
unavailable_fields.per_collective_pcie_nvlink_bytes: No collectives exist (communication off); device_telemetry supplies device-wide NVML PCIe rates, utilization and memory with native sampling windows, not per-collective or per-tensor bytes, and PCIe/NVLink traffic must not be inferred from logical payload or memcpy sizes.
unavailable_fields.cross_rank_clock_aligned_intervals: Single-process, single-device workload: observations.json ranks status=not_applicable (reason 'disabled') and cross_rank.matched is empty, so there is no second rank clock to align and no subtraction across rank clocks is permitted.
unavailable_fields.gradient_bucket_identity: Inference-only workload: coverage.json shows autograd_ranges=0, forward_linked_autograd_ranges=0 and backward_associated_kernels=0, so no gradients, buckets or communication hooks exist; exact bucket links require native correlation plus observed gradient-storage membership, neither of which is present, so any candidate mapping stays ambiguous rather than asserted.
unavailable_fields.cprofile_clean_throughput: python_runtime runs a perturbing warmed cProfile whose inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations, so it cannot certify the images_per_second >= 0.95x baseline constraint; that gate is measured by the source per-repeat protocol (synchronize, perf_counter_ns around one infer()) instead.
unavailable_fields.gpu_readiness_and_consumer_completion_bo: execution_timeline reports clock alignment bounds for CPU submission matching only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown, so these bounds are not collectable as closed intervals.

rationale: Frozen objective is process-level peak_allocated_bytes for one single-GPU FP32 ResNet-18 inference forward (batch 32, torch.inference_mode, GPU-resident input) under images_per_second >= 0.95x baseline with exact-output gates (request.json). The torch collector already ran and attribution is closed: coverage.json shows 103/103 CUDA kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 root-only, 0 autograd/backward ranges and 0 ambiguous forward sequences, so no open overlap, graph-tracing or attribution question justifies adding nsys. Communication is off (distributed_backend=null, communication='off'; observations.json communication capability not_applicable, ranks disabled), so nccl_tuning and collective_calibration have no collectives to sample and a synthetic full-world SUM allreduce reference would not inform this workload; both are excluded. device_telemetry reads device-wide NVML rates/utilization/memory with native windows and cannot attribute the process-level PyTorch CUDA allocated peak, which request.json explicitly distinguishes from whole-device or reserved memory. execution_timeline would duplicate the already-complete CPU-to-CUDA association from the torch trace, and its passive CPU gradient post-accumulate callbacks target backward/bucket analysis that does not exist in this inference workload; it never determines subsequent search actions. python_runtime perturbs execution and produces no clean timing usable for the throughput gate. candidate_diagnostics is therefore the single selected collector: it evaluates memory-reduction candidates under the exact per-repeat measurement protocol (torch.cuda.synchronize, reset_peak_memory_stats, one infer(), synchronize) with the quality gates, and the requested fields attribute the peak's composition (per-operator allocation attribution at the peak instant, stage-wise intermediate activation bytes, fixed share from FP32 parameters and the 32x3x224x224 FP32 input, reserved-vs-allocated context) so reduction targets the dominant transient activations rather than fixed weights or input, while missing dimensions are retained as unknown rather than inferred.
